intro: Deadwood Village is a furbolg encampment nestled in southern Felwood. Once a peaceful clan attuned to nature, its residents fell victim to the demonic corruption that blighted the surrounding forest. Driven mad by fel taint, the Deadwood furbolgs now attack anyone who approaches their crude wooden settlement.

p: Situated near the southern border of Felwood, Deadwood Village serves as the primary enclave of the Deadwood tribe. When the Burning Legion's demonic energies washed through the ancient woodlands, the furbolgs lacked the power to resist the creeping rot. Their minds warped by fel malice, they abandoned their ancient traditions and spiritual harmony. Today, the village is a squalid gathering of hostile brutes, shamans, and den watchers who violently defend their polluted grounds against intruders, earning the despair of their uncorrupted cousins, the Timbermaw.
